data.name: IppRequestRejected
data.value: The print system at '{0}' rejected the request with IPP status '{1}'.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. {1} is the IPP status code name.

data.name: IppConnectionFailed
data.value: Could not communicate with the print system at '{0}'.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. The inner exception has the details.

data.name: IppConnectionTimedOut
data.value: The print system at '{0}' did not answer in time.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. Raised when the connection doesn't open within the connect timeout, or a request other than Print-Job doesn't finish within the response timeout.

data.name: IppAuthenticationRequired
data.value: The print system at '{0}' needs a user name and password for this request.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. Raised for HTTP 401 or IPP client-error-not-authenticated when no credentials were configured.

data.name: IppCredentialsRejected
data.value: The print system at '{0}' did not accept the user name and password.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. Raised for HTTP 401 or IPP client-error-not-authenticated when credentials were sent.

data.name: IppEncryptedAuthenticationRequired
data.value: The print system at '{0}' needs a user name and password, sent over an encrypted connection, for this request.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. Raised for HTTP 426 when no credentials were configured: CUPS asks for encryption before it asks for a password.

data.name: IppEncryptionRequired
data.value: The print system at '{0}' only accepts the user name and password over an encrypted connection, but encryption is turned off.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. Raised for HTTP 426 when credentials were configured without encryption.

data.name: IppRequestForbidden
data.value: The print system at '{0}' does not allow this user to make this request.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. Raised for HTTP 403 or IPP client-error-not-authorized.

data.name: IppSecureConnectionFailed
data.value: Could not open an encrypted connection to the print system at '{0}'. CUPS servers use a self-signed certificate unless given another, which isn't trusted by default: check it in a server certificate validation callback.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. The inner exception has the TLS failure, such as an untrusted certificate.

data.name: IppResponseUnreadable
data.value: The print system at '{0}' sent an answer Latiprimere can't read.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. The inner exception says what couldn't be read, such as an answer cut short, a number too large or a value of the wrong type.

data.name: IppResponseNotIpp
data.value: The address '{0}' answered, but not with IPP. It may be a web page, such as a printer's or CUPS's web interface, rather than the IPP address of a printer or print server.
data.comment: {0} is the printer or server URI. Raised when the answer's Content-Type isn't application/ipp.

data.name: PrinterNoLongerAvailable
data.value: The printer at '{0}' could no longer be found.

data.name: IppResponseMissingJob
data.value: The print system at '{0}' accepted the job but did not return its job ID.

data.name: OutputFileNotSupported
data.value: IPP and CUPS printers cannot print to a file. Remove PrintOptions.OutputFile, or use a Windows printer.

data.name: DocumentFormatNotSupportedByPrinter
data.value: The printer does not accept '{0}' documents. It accepts: {1}.
data.comment: {0} is the MIME type sent, {1} the comma-separated MIME types the printer reports.

data.name: VendorOptionValueEmpty
data.value: The vendor option '{0}' has an empty value. Separate several values with single commas.
data.comment: {0} is the key, such as ipp:finishings.

data.name: VendorOptionNameInvalid
data.value: The vendor option '{0}' doesn't name an IPP attribute: after the prefix, use lower-case letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.', starting with a letter, such as ipp:print-quality.

data.name: VendorOptionSetByLatiprimere
data.value: The vendor option '{0}' sets {1}, which Latiprimere already sends for this job, from PrintOptions or for the request itself. Use the typed option instead, or leave it at its default.
data.comment: {0} is the key, {1} the IPP attribute name, such as copies.

data.name: VendorOptionSetTwice
data.value: The vendor options '{0}' and '{1}' both set {2}. Use one of them.
data.comment: {0} and {1} are the keys, such as ipp:print-quality and cups:print-quality; {2} the IPP attribute name.
